items.claim: Merging the image and audio runs dropped the image run's `at`, so Step never outlined its stage in a pipeline with audio stages
A slider's live preview values were recorded as undo steps, so a paused drag split into several steps and a canceled drag left a step that changed nothing
items.note: Previews now go through a new `PipelineDoc.preview`, which records no undo step. `change` records one step from the doc as it was before the drag, and `cancel` puts the preview back. The 500 ms coalesce window is gone, so two quick drags are no longer merged either (B's case c). 8c319d93df adds the new `preview` and `cancel` to a test stub that typecheck flagged.

items.claim: Replaced source images and the last one on unmount were never closed, leaking their ImageBitmaps
items.note: Closing one straight away could break a run still reading it. I added `EffectRunner.idle()` to `@weasel-js/diagram`, which settles once every run and step already asked for has finished. A replaced bitmap is closed after that, and the last one on unmount. Changeset `effect-runner-idle.md` (minor, `api`). The case B raised of a pick that finishes after unmount already worked: `chooseImage` closes a pick another pick has overtaken, and unmounting counts as one.

items.claim: Adding a stage from the palette left the previously picked group armed for Ungroup
Leaving pipeline mode during an audio decode showed a "Could not read the audio" toast it shouldn't have
items.note: A decode that fails for an unreadable file is still reported.
